title: Design- Lead menu reads Assign Tech and Reassign Lead Tech (design's version)
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682429 Ana.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two Approved work orders: {Work-order-1} with no lead technician and {Work-order-2} led by {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682429 Design Labels.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click the lead technician item.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-2}.
  5. Click the lead technician item.
  6. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu item reads "Assign Tech".
  • Step 2: the lead technician dialog opens with a "Search technicians" box.
  • Step 3: the dialog closes.
  • Step 4: the menu item reads "Reassign Lead Tech".
  • Step 5: the dialog titled "Reassign Lead Tech" opens.
  • Step 6: the dialog closes.

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: Menu and dialog wording for the lead technician: the design shows "Assign Tech" on a work order with no lead and "Reassign Lead Tech" on one with a lead (menu item and dialog title); the PRD says "Assign lead technician" and "Reassign lead technician". It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D01 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

What the PRD says instead:

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043

  • S3-R14: “Include the lead technician action in the card’s more-actions menu: “Assign lead technician” on a work order with no lead technician, “Reassign lead technician” on one that has a lead technician.”
  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the lead technician dialog, titled “Assign lead technician” or “Reassign lead technician” to match the menu item it was opened from (S3-R14).”
